gioi_han.ghi_chu: Van dat O MAY CHU. Hai loi goi CAU TRUC (station/getall, station/status) di LAN UU TIEN, khong bao gio bi chan. Tu 03/9/2026 lop tram mua chi con dung hai loi goi nay, nen tran 300/phut la rat rong - giu van lai de phong lop khac hoac bug lam bung so loi goi.

ghi_chu_chung: Do that 03/9/2026: mang RMA co 3.713 tram mua va 17 tram thuy van. PHAT HIEN quan trong: station/status voi than {from,to} tra ve trong truong last_data chinh la TONG LUONG MUA cua khoang do, cho toan mang, trong MOT loi goi - da doi chieu 10/10 tram khop tuyet doi voi phep cong tay tu station/fromto. Nen KHONG con phai quet tung tram o bat ky cua so nao, ke ca che do Lich. Moi cua so (3h/12h/24h/48h/72h/Lich) deu ton dung 1 loi goi.
